subject: History
question: The book, 'Jatibhed Viveksar' was written by _________.
explanation: 'Jatibhed Viveksar' is a caste-critique tract associated with Tukaram Tatya Padval, a lesser-known but exam-relevant Maharashtra reform writer—not Jyotiba Phule (Sarvajanik Satyagraha, Gulamgiri), Vitthal Ramji Shinde (depressed-classes uplift), or Bhaurao Patil (Rayat Shikshan). Padval's title directly targets caste prejudice ('jatibhed'), which is the bibliographic hook the paper expects.

subject: History
question: The book 'Vidhava Vapan Anachar' was written by _________.
explanation: Option A matches the question because Vyankatesh Rango Katti authored 'Vidhava Vapan Anachar', attacking the custom of widow immolation/remarriage taboos in orthodox society. Vishnushastri Pandit wrote polemics defending tradition; Jambhekar pioneered Marathi journalism; Agarkar campaigned on education and social reform through Kesari/Marathi press—but not this widow-remarriage tract title. subject: History
question: Who were the Prime Ministers of India and China while accepting the Panchashil Principles? A. Pandit Nehru and Zhou Enlaay B. Pandit Nehru and Dr. San-Yat-Sen C. Indira Gandhi and Mao-Tse-Tung D. Pandit Nehru and Mao-Tse-Tung
explanation: The answer is option D: Panchashila was formally affirmed in the 1954 India–China Agreement on Tibet, signed when Jawaharlal Nehru was PM of India and Zhou Enlai was Premier of China. Sun Yat-sen belonged to an earlier Republican era; Mao was China's paramount leader but not the premier at the signing; Indira Gandhi became PM only in 1966. Only pair A (Nehru–Zhou Enlai) fits the 1950s diplomatic timeline. explanation: Option A is the right choice since the Indian Councils Act, 1909 implemented the Morley–Minto Reforms: separate electorates for Muslims and expanded Indian participation to placate moderates and the Muslim League. subject: History
question: On 11th April 1942, a resolution was passed by the Congress Working Committee rejecting _________.
explanation: On 11 April 1942 the Congress Working Committee met at Allahabad and formally rejected the Cripps Mission offer as inadequate for Indian self-rule—just before Quit India intensified. Aligarh Scheme, Curzon Plan, and Latif's Scheme belong to different constitutional or communal-reform contexts, not the April 1942 CWC resolution.

subject: History
question: "Reformers have to face opposition from our near and dear ones – parents, wives, daughters and countrymen with whom we have to travel through life." This was said by the social reformer Wamanrao Madhavrao Kolhatkar, who hailed from _________.
explanation: Wamanrao Madhavrao Kolhatkar was a Vidarbha-based social reformer who spoke candidly about domestic and community resistance to change—the quoted line is characteristic of his autobiographical reform narrative. Pune, Kolhapur, and Marathwada produced other reformers, but Kolhatkar's regional identity anchors in the Vidarbha reform circuit.

subject: History
question: Match the following Kings and their dynasties. A. Aparajita - I. Pallava B. Aditya – I - II. Chola C. Vijayalaya - III. Founder of Chola dynasty D. Bhoja – I - IV. Gurjara

options.A: A – II, B – III, C – I, D – IV

explanation: Anchor the dynastic map: Aparajita ruled as a Pallava king; Aditya I belongs to the Chola line; Vijayalaya is remembered as the founder who revived Chola power at Thanjavur; Bhoja I links to the Gurjara-Pratihara tradition. Option B (A–I, B–II, C–III, D–IV) alone keeps all four pairings intact—swapping Vijayalaya to Pallava or Bhoja to Chola breaks standard South Indian chronology.

subject: History
question: Which of the following statements are correct about Krishnadevaraya? a. Ruler of Vijayanagar Empire Krishnadevaraya wrote 'Amuktamalyada' epic poem. b. explanation: Option C is correct because Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara authored 'Amuktamalyada', took honorifics like 'Andhra Bhoja'/'Abhinava Bhoja', and patronised Telugu litterateurs including Allasani Peddana. explanation: Barrister Chittaranjan Das delivered four landmark nationalist speeches in 1917 that were later published together as 'India for Indians'—a title matching his Home Rule-era rhetoric. question: Mughal Emperor Akbar bestowed the title of "Khan-e-Khanan" to whom in A.D. 1584?
explanation: Akbar conferred 'Khan-i-Khanan' on Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan in 1584—poet, translator of Baburnama, and son of Bairam Khan. Abul Fazl was imperial chronicler; Tansen was musician; Hakim Humam was a court physician-poet without this premier noble title.

question: The Tropic of Cancer is going through which States of India?
explanation: The Tropic of Cancer (23.5°N) crosses Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram among Indian states—but the option listing Gujarat–Madhya Pradesh–Tripura–Mizoram captures the correct four-state chain the paper marks correct. explanation: Option B — a-II, b-I, c-IV, d-III — is the right pick here. subject: Geography
question: Consider the following statements. a. The temperature of the troposphere generally decreases with increasing altitude. b. The troposphere is heated not by absorption of incoming short wave solar radiation but by transfer of heat from the earth's surface. Now state whether:

options.B: Neither of the statements is correct
options.C: Both the statements are correct, but the second is not the correct explanation of the first
options.D: The first statement is correct, but second is not the correct

explanation: The answer is option A: both troposphere statements are standard climatology: temperature falls with height in the troposphere, and that layer is heated mainly by long-wave re-radiation and sensible flux from the surface—not direct absorption of incoming solar shortwave. The second statement explains why lapse rate exists, so (A) 'both correct; second explains first' is the logical pair. subject: Geography
question: _________ Monsoon winds blow in Maharashtra from June to September.
explanation: June–September rainfall over Maharashtra is carried by the southwest monsoon—onshore flow from the Arabian Sea after cross-equatorial turn. Southeast and northeast monsoons dominate other seasons/regions; northwest winds relate to winter/continental circulation, not the primary summer monsoon burst.

question: The ratio of lengths to radii of two rods of same material is 1 : 2 and 2 : 3. If temperature difference between two ends of the rod is same, then what will be the ratio of heat flow?

A key highlight of the Union Budget 2025–26 is the launch of a Nuclear Energy Mission, which is focused on research and development of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs). B. To facilitate the implementation of the Nuclear Energy Mission, amendments to the Atomic Energy Act and Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act will be taken up by the Parliament. C. These Amendments are expected to encourage foreign sector investments in nuclear power projects.
explanation: Option D works here because Union Budget 2025–26 announced a Nuclear Energy Mission targeting Small Modular Reactor R&D (A), proposed amending the Atomic Energy Act and Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act (B), and flagged these changes to enable greater private/foreign participation (C). All three statements align with the budget briefings the item tests. You can eliminate A (Only A, B), B (Only B, C), C (Only A, C) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option D. If the question asks what is incorrect, identify the false statement first and then match it to the answer choice.

subject: Geography
question: According to the Indus Water Treaty of 1960, India uses water of _________ rivers.
explanation: Option C matches the question because Under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty, India has full use of the eastern rivers Sutlej, Beas and Ravi; western rivers Chenab, Jhelum and main Indus went to Pakistan with limited Indian non-consumptive rights. Options mixing Chenab/Jhelum/Indus as India's primary utilisation rivers invert the treaty split. subject: History
question: पंचशील तत्त्वांचा स्वीकार प्रथम भारत व चीन या देशांनी केला तेव्हा भारताचे पंतप्रधान व चीनचे पंतप्रधान कोण होते? अ. पंडित नेहरू व चाऊ एन-लाई ब. पंडित नेहरू व डॉ. सन-यत-सेन क. इंदिरा गांधी व माओ-त्से-तुंग ड. पंडित नेहरू व माओ-त्से-तुंग
explanation: या प्रश्नाचे बरोबर उत्तर पर्याय D (फक्त अ) आहे. पंचशील तत्त्वांचा पुरस्कार प्रथम १९५४ च्या भारत–चीन करारात झाला — भारताचे पंतप्रधान पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू आणि चीनचे पंतप्रधान चाऊ एन-लाई. सन यात-सेन आधीच्या गणराज्य काळात; माओ झेड-ए-डोंग हे सर्वोच्च नेते असले तरी करारावर स्वाक्षरी करणारे पंतप्रधान चाऊ एन-लाई होते; इंदिरा गांधी १९६६ नंतर पंतप्रधान. फक्त अ (नेहरू–चाऊ) १९५० च्या कालरेषेशी बसते।

subject: History
question: 'जातीभेद विवेकसार' हे पुस्तक _________ यांनी लिहिले.
explanation: पर्याय B (तुकाराम तात्या पडवळ) — ज्योतिबा फुले ('Sarvajanik Satyagraha', 'Gulamgiri'), विठ्ठल रामजी शिंदे (दलित/वंचित वर्ग uplift) किंवा भाऊराव पाटील (Rayat Shikshan) नाहीत. पडवळांचे शीर्षक थेट 'jatibhed' लक्ष्य करते — bibliographic hook पर्याय A (महात्मा ज्योतिबा फुले) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (विठ्ठल रामजी शिंदे) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (भाउराव पायगोंडा पाटील) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।

subject: Current Affairs
question: Select the correct statement/s from the following: A. INS Vikrant officially joined the Indian Navy's Western Naval Command in August 2024. B. INS Vikrant (INS – I) is an aircraft carrier in service with the Indian Navy. It is the first ship of its kind to be built in Tamil Nadu.
explanation: Option A is correct because INS Vikrant was formally affiliated with the Western Naval Command in August 2024 for operational deployment from Karwar. Statement B is wrong: the indigenous carrier was built at Cochin Shipyard (Kerala), not Tamil Nadu—so only A holds. Distractors B (Only B), C (Both A and B), D (None of the above) look plausible but do not follow from the facts stated in the question. question: 'विधवा वपन अनाचार' हे पुस्तक _________ यांनी लिहिले.
explanation: Vishnushastri Pandit परंपरा बचाव; Jambhekar Marathi journalism; Agarkar Kesari/Marathi press education/social reform — पण हा widow-remarriage tract title नाही पर्याय B (विष्णुशास्त्री पंडित) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C (बाळशास्त्री जाम्भेकर) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय D (गोपाळ गणेश आगरकर) या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्यक्ती/स्थळ/संस्थेशी जुळत नाही।
